phase: the checkpoint directory made immutable while a resume was committing
detail: The store — the checkpoint directory itself — was made immutable with chflags uchg while a resume process was writing its post-approval checkpoint. That process exited 134 and its own output says why: the framework could not create a checkpoint. So the commit it was making did not happen and no partial checkpoint was left — the directory held 1 checkpoint file(s) at the gate. What is left is the gate checkpoint, still holding the plan-review request (62c3cdc159aa430ba906e4b3ec2d097f): with the flag removed, a fresh resume exited 0, answered the request again (1 re-approvals), wrote checkpoint f2e6d316e5f44e6c967af9134d30ee2e, and left a post-approval checkpoint: yes. That is a clean failure and also a limit: the baseline's gate has no way to say it has already been answered, so the same approval is still there to be applied a second time.
